Bill.BriefDescription: Providing uninterrupted meal and rest breaks for hospital employees.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to meal and rest breaks for employees of hospitals;and adding a new section to chapter 49.12 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 49.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A hospital licensed under chapter 70.41 RCW shall provideemployees uninterrupted thirtyminute meal breaks and rest breaks of atleast ten minutes or as otherwise agreed to be provided by theemployer, whichever is longer, unless there is: (a) An unforeseeable emergent circumstance as defined in RCW49.28.130; or (b) A clinical circumstance that may lead to patient harm withoutthe specific skill or expertise of the employee on break. (2) Rest breaks may be taken at any point during each fourhourwork period during which the employee is required to receive the restbreak. (3) Reporting a missed break is not grounds for discrimination, p. 1 SHB 3024dismissal, discharge, or any other penalty, threat of reports fordiscipline, or employment decision adverse to the employee.
